description: This course familiarizes students with the fundamentals of computing devices. It introduces microprocessor concepts, memory-mapped I/O systems, and interfacing techniques. Topics include ARM architecture and assembly programming, and memory-mapped peripherals. The course culminates in an assignment where students design and implement a system that integrates hardware and software to deliver an efficient engineering solution
